# VexFlow 4.2.5

Music Lab imports the locally bundled Bravura build when the notation workspace opens. The JavaScript comes from the official `vexflow@4.2.5` npm archive at `package/build/cjs/vexflow-bravura.js`. The source map directive was removed because the simulator serves only the browser bundle.

- [VexFlow source at commit `5b5b43b18254cc5cf607a0977823900a375b48ed`](https://github.com/0xfe/vexflow/tree/5b5b43b18254cc5cf607a0977823900a375b48ed)
- npm archive SHA-256 `7d6d532c640b463f0f9dc03e3ec699a16a918432792b5326d3c01650f7c7d968`
- The VexFlow MIT notice is in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The embedded Bravura glyphs are covered by [BRAVURA-OFL.txt](BRAVURA-OFL.txt).
